item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 05/Feb/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of a fresh to strong easterly airstream, it will be cloudier gradually with one or two light rain patches over the coast of Guangdong in the next couple of days. The weather will remain cool in the morning. An intense winter monsoon is expected to reach the coast of southern China towards the weekend. The weather will be cold in the morning over the region during the weekend. It will be very cold over inland areas. The weather will improve over southern China early next week, and it will be very dry during the day. With the monsoon being replaced by an easterly airstream, temperatures will rise over the coast of Guangdong midweek next week.
